description: Influencer Factory Command Center — synthetic-persona creators that publish across Blotato platforms. Admin-only. Phase 1 surface: persona CRUD (auto-creates a Featured MIND row with IF fields), face anchor (AI-generate via Nano Banana Pro OR user-uploaded with rights affirmation), face variants (image-to-image via n8n + Fal.ai, always pinned to anchor — never chained), voice (ElevenLabs library search + clone + sample), per-platform bios (with optional LLM draft), Blotato account registration (YouTube/IG/LinkedIn/X/Threads/Pinterest; TikTok marked manual_upload). Each persona is publicly chattable at /m/{username} via its linked Featured MIND.

action.description: What to do. Start with 'health' to confirm Fal/ElevenLabs/Blotato/S3/n8n are configured. Most write actions require persona_mind_id.

agent_posting_enabled.description: Master kill-switch on the linked Featured MIND row. Off = autonomous posters skip this persona.

archetype_id.description: Persona archetype template id (looked up in persona_archetypes catalog).

bios.description: Map of platform → bio text (twitter|instagram|tiktok|linkedin|youtube|threads|pinterest). Length-capped server-side.

daily_credit_ceiling_usd.description: Hard ceiling on daily Fal.ai/ElevenLabs/Veo/Suno spend for this persona. Default 5.

generate_with_llm.description: If true, LLM drafts missing platform bios. Existing bios stay.

kg_scope_template_id.description: Knowledge-graph scope template id (bounds what this persona 'knows about').

niche_tags.description: Topic niche tags used by retrieval (separate from Featured MIND catalog tags).

page_id.description: LinkedIn / IG / YouTube page id (optional, platform-specific).

persona_mind_id.description: Persona id (== featured_minds.mind_id). Required for every per-persona action.

pillars.description: 3–5 content pillars the persona writes about.

prompt.description: Anchor-face generation prompt OR voice sample text (anchor_face_ai_generate, generate_voice_sample).

prompt_modifier.description: Optional modifier appended to the base variant prompt (e.g. 'outdoor golden hour').

username.description: Lowercase username (3–32 chars, [a-z0-9_-]). Used for /m/{username} public landing AND the featured_minds row. Required for create_persona.

voice_name.description: Display name to store for the voice (set_voice_library).

voice_text.description: Text to render as a sample MP3 (generate_voice_sample).

name: mind_personas
